## 🎵 Create Your Own Song

Welcome to the **Song Generation Lab**! In this ludic activity, you'll:

1. **Write lyrics or narrative** based on economic concepts from Topic 2
2. **Provide a music prompt** (genre, mood, style)
3. **ACE-Step 1.5 generates the music locally** to accompany your words
4. **Reflect** on the creative process and economic ideas

> **Note:** This activity uses **ACE-Step 1.5**, a free, open-source music generation model running locally. No API keys needed!

---

## Your Creative Input

<div class="song-form">
  <label for="student-name"><strong>Name</strong></label>

  <label for="lyrics"><strong>Lyrics or narrative</strong></label>
  <textarea id="lyrics" rows="6" placeholder="Write about inflation, interest rates, money demand..."></textarea>

## 🤖 AI Music Generation with ACE-Step 1.5

<div id="song-result">
  <audio id="song-audio" controls style="width: 100%; display: none;"></audio>
  <div id="song-summary"></div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  var statusEl = document.getElementById("song-status");
  var audioEl = document.getElementById("song-audio");
  var summaryEl = document.getElementById("song-summary");
  var generateBtn = document.getElementById("generate-song");
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var API_BASE = (
    window.ACESTEP_API_BASE ||
    params.get("acestep_api") ||
    "http://localhost:8001"
  ).replace(/\/+$/, "");

  function setStatus(text, isError) {
    statusEl.textContent = text;
    statusEl.style.borderLeftColor = isError ? "#dc3545" : "#0d6efd";
    statusEl.style.backgroundColor = isError ? "#fff5f5" : "#f0f7ff";
    statusEl.style.color = isError ? "#dc3545" : "#0c63e4";
  }

  function sleep(ms) {
    return new Promise(function(resolve) { setTimeout(resolve, ms); });
  }

  function htmlEscape(text) {
    return String(text).replace(/[&<>\"]/g, function(ch) {
      return {"&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", "\"": "&quot;"}[ch];
    });
  }

  function isLocalPage() {
    return window.location.hostname === "localhost" ||
      window.location.hostname === "127.0.0.1" ||
      window.location.protocol === "file:";
  }

  function isLocalApi() {
    return /^https?:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)(:\d+)?$/i.test(API_BASE);
  }

  generateBtn.addEventListener("click", async function() {
    var name = document.getElementById("student-name").value.trim();
    var lyrics = document.getElementById("lyrics").value.trim();
    var prompt = document.getElementById("prompt").value.trim();

    if (!lyrics || !prompt) {
      setStatus("Please enter both lyrics and a music prompt.", true);
      return;
    }

    audioEl.style.display = "none";
    summaryEl.innerHTML = "";
    generateBtn.disabled = true;

    if (isLocalApi()) {
      setStatus("Submitting job to ACE-Step API on " + API_BASE + " ...", false);
    } else {
      setStatus("Submitting job to hosted ACE-Step backend: " + API_BASE, false);
    }

    var payload = {
      lyrics: lyrics,
      prompt: prompt,
      audio_duration: 30,
      inference_steps: 8,
      use_format: true,
      thinking: true
    };

    try {
      var releaseResponse = await fetch(API_BASE + "/release_task", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      });

      if (!releaseResponse.ok) {
        console.error("release_task error: HTTP " + releaseResponse.status);
        setStatus("ACE-Step API error (HTTP " + releaseResponse.status + ") while creating the job.", true);
        return;
      }

      var releaseJson = await releaseResponse.json();
      var taskId = releaseJson && releaseJson.data && releaseJson.data.task_id;
      if (!taskId) {
        console.error("Unexpected /release_task response:", releaseJson);
        setStatus("ACE-Step responded but no task ID was returned.", true);
        return;
      }

      var audioFileUrl = null;
      var maxPolls = 120;
      for (var i = 0; i < maxPolls; i++) {
        setStatus("Generating song... queue check " + (i + 1) + "/" + maxPolls, false);
        await sleep(3000);

        var queryResponse = await fetch(API_BASE + "/query_result", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
          body: JSON.stringify({ task_id_list: [taskId] })
        });

        if (!queryResponse.ok) {
          console.error("query_result error: HTTP " + queryResponse.status);
          setStatus("Failed to check job status (HTTP " + queryResponse.status + ").", true);
          return;
        }

        var queryJson = await queryResponse.json();
        var item = queryJson && queryJson.data && queryJson.data[0];
        if (!item) {
          continue;
        }

        if (item.status === 2) {
          console.error("ACE-Step job failed:", item);
          setStatus("ACE-Step reported a generation failure. Check the API terminal logs.", true);
          return;
        }

        if (item.status === 1) {
          var parsed = [];
          try {
            parsed = item.result ? JSON.parse(item.result) : [];
          } catch (e) {
            console.error("Could not parse result payload:", e, item.result);
          }
          if (parsed.length && parsed[0].file) {
            audioFileUrl = parsed[0].file;
          }
          break;
        }
      }

      if (!audioFileUrl) {
        setStatus("Timed out waiting for ACE-Step. Try again or check the API terminal.", true);
        return;
      }

      var audioUrl = audioFileUrl.indexOf("http") === 0 ? audioFileUrl : (API_BASE + audioFileUrl);
      audioEl.src = audioUrl;
      audioEl.style.display = "block";
      setStatus("Song generated successfully.", false);

      summaryEl.innerHTML =
        "<p><strong>Student:</strong> " + htmlEscape(name || "Anonymous") + "</p>" +
        "<p><strong>Lyrics:</strong><br>" + htmlEscape(lyrics).replace(/\n/g, "<br>") + "</p>" +
        "<p><strong>Music prompt:</strong> " + htmlEscape(prompt) + "</p>";
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("ACE-Step error:", err);
      setStatus(
        "Could not connect to ACE-Step API at " + API_BASE +
        (isLocalApi()
          ? ". Start it with uv run acestep-api (in ACE-Step-1.5)."
          : ". Check that the hosted backend is running, HTTPS is enabled, and CORS allows this GitHub Pages domain."),
        true
      );
    } finally {
      generateBtn.disabled = false;
    }
  });
})();
</script>

## 📚 Reflection Questions

After listening to your generated song, consider:

1. **Authorship & Creativity**: How did you and the AI contribute to this song? Who is the "author"?

2. **Economic Concepts**: Does the music reflect the economic themes in your lyrics? Why or why not?

3. **Limitations**: What did the AI do well? What would you change or improve?

4. **Monetary Economics Connection**: How could this creative approach help explain monetary policy concepts to others?

5. **Ethical Reflection**: In what ways is this different from a student writing a song entirely on their own?

## 🔧 Setup Instructions: ACE-Step 1.5

This activity uses **ACE-Step 1.5**, a free, open-source music generation model that runs **locally on your computer**. No API keys needed!

### Step 1: Install ACE-Step (One-time setup)

**Windows/macOS/Linux:**

```bash
# 1) Install uv (universal Python package manager)
# Go to: https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh
# Windows: Download and run the installer
# Or use PowerShell:
powershell -ExecutionPolicy BypassUser -c "irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex"

# 2) Clone the ACE-Step repository
git clone https://github.com/ACE-Step/ACE-Step-1.5.git
cd ACE-Step-1.5

# 3) Install dependencies
uv sync
```

### Step 2: Start the ACE-Step API

Before running the activity, start the API in a separate terminal:

```bash
cd ACE-Step-1.5
uv run acestep-api
```

You should see:
```
INFO:     Uvicorn running on http://127.0.0.1:8001
```

**Keep this terminal open while students use the activity.**

### Step 3: Run the Activity

With the API running, open this file (`topic2ludic.qmd`) in Quarto Preview:

```bash
quarto preview topic2ludic.qmd
```

Students enter their lyrics and music preferences, and ACE-Step generates the audio locally.

### Step 4: Optional - Use the Gradio UI

If preferred, students can also use ACE-Step's built-in UI:

```bash
uv run acestep
```

Then open `http://localhost:7860` in a browser.

---

## ✅ Why ACE-Step 1.5?

- **Free & Open-source** — No subscriptions or API keys
- **Local generation** — Runs entirely on your computer
- **Fast** — Optimized for modern GPUs (CPU supported too)
- **Multi-language** — Supports lyrics in many languages
- **Lyric-aware** — Conditions music generation on student-written content
- **Scalable** — No rate limits for 10 concurrent student groups
- **Educational** — Clear boundary: students write meaning, AI generates sound
